boundary: This freeze is for a clean-room synthetic execution with a seeded generator separated from the evaluator. It is not empirical support, not external adjudication, and does not validate consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, agency, moral status, or the full QICN framework.
negative_control_rule: Every negative control must fail the same support rule or the run becomes a destruction candidate or quarantine candidate.
destruction_rule: If any valid negative control satisfies the support rule, the selectivity claim is a destruction candidate unless the reviewer quarantines the run for a protocol violation.
anti_inflation_rule: A positive clean-room synthetic run may be recorded only as clean_room_synthetic_support. It must not be promoted to empirical support or external adjudication.
